_note: PLAYER'S PART (2026-11-04, his ask, beats written on his 'sounds good, write the beats'): take the kit back: she left it out, and scavengers found it first. A small clear at the kit, under the same 'Meet the contact' objective, so the no-show is still a surprise; then the note. Overrides Frances's 'nothing hostile' on his 11-04 yes.
THE MEET-UP: a new board family, his idea. The job is turning up; the story is who is there and what they want. Talks at a placed person are built, so most letters need nothing new.
Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. No names, places or currency in any voiced line.
LETTER b: THE NO-SHOW: nobody is there. Her kit is, with a note: her sister's having a baby and she has the only ship. Nothing hostile, nothing explained further.

FRANCES 2026-10-31 (reviews/2026-10-31-delve-MB93b.md): ship, findings 1-3 taken (the initial dropped, so a repeat draw is not the same person twice); 4 holds because the objective marker is the kit itself. Forced pick answered NO: the broker learns of the absence as the player did.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Meet a contact at the <Place> on <Planet> and collect the kit she is bringing. Payment on completion."

LEVEL AND DISTANCE 2026-11-11 (his: 'some quests shouldnt be given to a level 1 player' and 'not sending them across the whole map just to deliver a coffee'; Eliza's minLevel and place.parsecs, FrankyCLI 3c81f6a): parsecs 12: an easy or med job stays within about 40 systems of him.

place._theme: Any built site where two people could arrange to meet: no caves, no natural landmarks.

message.title: A Note on the Kit
message.text: Couldn't wait. My sister's having her baby and I'm the only one with a ship. Everything you came for is in here. Sorry.

say: The kit's on your manifest. If she didn't stay to hand it over, she had a reason. I won't ask.
